contact.basis: Original public mountaintop terrain at the named monastery point. The original field controls nearby exterior levels.

verticalDatum: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 surface heights relative to EGM2008.
attribution: Copernicus DEM GLO-30 © DLR e.V. and Airbus Defence and Space GmbH
method: Unaltered Copernicus DSM Float32 values bilinearly sampled at the declared sample centers in a fixed local geographic frame. A separate Terrarium tile returned missing values throughout.
limitations: The DSM includes surfaces such as rooftops and canopy. The 2 m review grid oversamples the original 30 m source.

The tourism guide distinguishes the 1,318 m Throni summit from the lower monastery. A geolocated field sample at Kykkos reports 1,130 m, close to the original Copernicus surface level. Model foundation alignment remains approximate.
